what_changed: CFPB advance notice of proposed rulemaking on amending the Regulation V definitions of 'identity theft' and 'identity theft report' to cover coerced debt (transactions without the consumer's effective consent), with related amendments.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if a rule follows, furnishers would need to handle coerced-debt claims like identity theft claims in disputes and blocking.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: How does the deployment currently route borrower statements that a debt was coerced or taken out without consent?
rationale: ANPR on furnisher and CRA treatment of coerced debt; it would change dispute handling by furnishers, but proposes no text yet. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
